$doc: WP14 QA presets (§7.4). Each preset is a list of shots {name, page?, params, size?, wait?, eval?[], expect?, captures?, diff?, diffWith?, allowWarnings?, fresh?}. fresh: true boots the shot on its own page (never moved in place from another shot, never served from the capture memo), so spawn-determinism still tests boot determinism. expect.class: lit | dark | darkFlash | mixed | none (default: derived from params; an unforced lit shot standing in a naturally DARK district becomes mixed); expect.level0: false skips the Level 0 hue/sat rule. Evals may return {fail: [...], warn: [...]}. Run: npm run qa [-- --preset a,b] [--only regex] [--baseline dir]. Preset 'ui' walks the title / settings / enter / pause flow (autostart=0 overrides the appended autostart=1: the first value wins).

captures.eval: (async () => { const b = __backrooms; const f = b.flickerWindow(10); if (!f) return { fail: ['flicker: no FLICKER light in view after goto=flicker'] }; window.__qaFlicker = f; b.setTime(f.high); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const ev = b.stats().exposure.ev100; b.setExposure(ev); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const s = await b.imageStats(); window.__qaFlickerGrid = s.grid3x3; return { window: f, ev100: ev, meanLum: +s.meanLum.toFixed(4) }; })()

captures.name: burst
captures.eval: (async () => { const b = __backrooms; const f = window.__qaFlicker; if (!f) return { fail: ['flicker: no steady capture'] }; b.setTime(f.low); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const s = await b.imageStats(); b.setExposure(null); const g0 = window.__qaFlickerGrid; const drops = s.grid3x3.map((v, i) => +(g0[i] - v).toFixed(4)); const d = Math.max(...drops); return { meanLum: +s.meanLum.toFixed(4), drops, fail: d < 0.015 ? ['flicker: no third of the burst frame (t ' + f.low + ', level ' + f.lowLevel.toFixed(2) + ') is visibly darker than in the steady one (t ' + f.high + ') at the same exposure: max drop ' + d.toFixed(4)] : [] }; })()

views.$note: R2 B9: goto=flicker aims at the FLICKER light; flickerWindow() gives a steady time and a time inside its next burst (its last LOW slot); at a locked exposure (setTime snaps the auto exposure, which would hide the dip) some third of the burst frame (imageStats grid3x3) must be >= 0.015 darker

captures.name: before
captures.eval: (async () => { const b = __backrooms; const C = 1.2; const p0 = b.stats().player; const T = new Map(); for (let dz = -14; dz <= 14; dz++) for (let dx = -14; dx <= 14; dx++) { const c = b.cellAt(p0.x + dx * C, p0.z + dz * C); if (c && (c.flags & 32)) T.set(c.gi + ',' + c.gj, c); } const isT = (i, j) => T.has(i + ',' + j); const D = { W: [-1, 0], N: [0, -1], E: [1, 0], S: [0, 1] }; let X = null, best = Infinity; for (const c of T.values()) for (const k of Object.keys(D)) { const [di, dj] = D[k]; if (c.edges[k] !== 'DOORWAY' || isT(c.gi + di, c.gj + dj)) continue; const w = [[-dj, di], [dj, -di]].find(([a, e]) => [1, 2, 3, 4].every((n) => isT(c.gi + a * n, c.gj + e * n) && isT(c.gi - di + a * n, c.gj - dj + e * n) && isT(c.gi - 2 * di + a * n, c.gj - 2 * dj + e * n))); if (!w || !isT(c.gi - di, c.gj - dj) || !isT(c.gi - 2 * di, c.gj - 2 * dj)) continue; const dd = Math.hypot((c.gi + 0.5) * C - p0.x, (c.gj + 0.5) * C - p0.z); if (dd < best) { best = dd; X = { i: c.gi, j: c.gj, d: [di, dj], w }; } } const at = (u, v) => X && ({ x: (X.i - (2 - u) * X.d[0] + (4 - v) * X.w[0] + 0.5) * C, z: (X.j - (2 - u) * X.d[1] + (4 - v) * X.w[1] + 0.5) * C }); const yawTo = (a, e) => Math.atan2(-(e.x - a.x), -(e.z - a.z)); if (!X) return { fail: ['tower: no tower (storey doorway + 3x5 footprint) within 14 cells after goto=tower'] }; const e1 = at(0.5, 4), e0 = at(0.5, 0); const yaw = yawTo(e1, e0); window.__qaTower = { x: e1.x, z: e1.z, s: p0.s, yaw }; await b.teleport({ x: e1.x, z: e1.z, s: p0.s, y: -1.45, yaw, pitch: 0.05 }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); const st = b.stats().player; const img = await b.imageStats(); const fail = []; if (st.s !== p0.s || Math.abs(st.y + 1.45) > 0.05) fail.push('tower: before-capture pose moved (s ' + st.s + ', y ' + st.y + ')'); if (!(img.meanLum >= 0.05) || img.black > 0.5) fail.push('tower: mid-landing view is dark (meanLum ' + img.meanLum.toFixed(3) + ', black ' + img.black.toFixed(2) + '): the diff would be vacuous'); return { at: st, meanLum: img.meanLum, cells: T.size, fail }; })()

captures.name: after

tower.name: tower-walk
eval: (async () => { const b = __backrooms; const C = 1.2; const p0 = b.stats().player; const T = new Map(); for (let dz = -14; dz <= 14; dz++) for (let dx = -14; dx <= 14; dx++) { const c = b.cellAt(p0.x + dx * C, p0.z + dz * C); if (c && (c.flags & 32)) T.set(c.gi + ',' + c.gj, c); } const isT = (i, j) => T.has(i + ',' + j); const D = { W: [-1, 0], N: [0, -1], E: [1, 0], S: [0, 1] }; let X = null, best = Infinity; for (const c of T.values()) for (const k of Object.keys(D)) { const [di, dj] = D[k]; if (c.edges[k] !== 'DOORWAY' || isT(c.gi + di, c.gj + dj)) continue; const w = [[-dj, di], [dj, -di]].find(([a, e]) => [1, 2, 3, 4].every((n) => isT(c.gi + a * n, c.gj + e * n) && isT(c.gi - di + a * n, c.gj - dj + e * n) && isT(c.gi - 2 * di + a * n, c.gj - 2 * dj + e * n))); if (!w || !isT(c.gi - di, c.gj - dj) || !isT(c.gi - 2 * di, c.gj - 2 * dj)) continue; const dd = Math.hypot((c.gi + 0.5) * C - p0.x, (c.gj + 0.5) * C - p0.z); if (dd < best) { best = dd; X = { i: c.gi, j: c.gj, d: [di, dj], w }; } } const at = (u, v) => X && ({ x: (X.i - (2 - u) * X.d[0] + (4 - v) * X.w[0] + 0.5) * C, z: (X.j - (2 - u) * X.d[1] + (4 - v) * X.w[1] + 0.5) * C }); const yawTo = (a, e) => Math.atan2(-(e.x - a.x), -(e.z - a.z)); if (!X) return { fail: ['tower walk: no tower (storey doorway + 3x5 footprint) within 14 cells after goto=tower'] }; const a0 = at(0, 0), a1 = at(0, 4), b1 = at(1, 4), b0 = at(1, 0); await b.teleport({ x: a0.x, z: a0.z, s: p0.s, y: 0, yaw: yawTo(a0, a1), pitch: 0 }); const s0 = b.stats().player.s; const programs0 = b.stats().render.programs; const trace = []; let lastS = null, polling = true; const poll = (async () => { while (polling) { const s = b.stats().player.s; if (s !== lastS) { trace.push(s); lastS = s; } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); } })(); const perfP = b.perf(16); const w = await b.walk([a1, b1, b0], 1.45); const perf = await perfP; polling = false; await poll; const s = b.stats(); const switches = trace.length - 1; const fail = []; if (perf.frameMs.max >= 50) fail.push('tower walk: max frame ' + perf.frameMs.max.toFixed(1) + ' ms >= 50'); if (s.render.programs !== programs0) fail.push('tower walk: programs ' + programs0 + ' -> ' + s.render.programs); if (switches < 1 || s.player.s !== (s0 + 1) % 3) fail.push('tower walk: expected one switch to storey ' + (s0 + 1) % 3 + ', got ' + switches + ' switch(es), now storey ' + s.player.s + ' y ' + s.player.y); if (Math.hypot(s.player.x - b0.x, s.player.z - b0.z) > 0.6) fail.push('tower walk: did not reach the end0 landing (stopped at ' + s.player.x.toFixed(2) + ', ' + s.player.z.toFixed(2) + ')'); return { walk: w, perf, switches, storeys: trace, end: s.player, programs: [programs0, s.render.programs], fail }; })()

tower.name: elevator-ride
eval: (async () => { const b = __backrooms; const C = 1.2; const p = b.stats().player; const cells = []; for (let dz = -12; dz <= 12; dz++) for (let dx = -12; dx <= 12; dx++) { const c = b.cellAt(p.x + dx * C, p.z + dz * C); if (c && (c.flags & 64)) cells.push(c); } const uniq = [...new Map(cells.map((c) => [c.gi + ',' + c.gj, c])).values()]; if (!uniq.length) return { fail: ['elevator: no ELEVATOR cells within 12 cells after goto=elevator'] }; const dist = (c) => Math.hypot((c.gi + 0.5) * C - p.x, (c.gj + 0.5) * C - p.z); const a = uniq.reduce((m, c) => (dist(c) < dist(m) ? c : m)); const near = uniq.filter((c) => Math.abs(c.gi - a.gi) <= 2 && Math.abs(c.gj - a.gj) <= 2); const isE = (i, j) => near.some((c) => c.gi === i && c.gj === j); const D = { W: [-1, 0], N: [0, -1], E: [1, 0], S: [0, 1] }; const cab = near.filter((c) => !Object.keys(D).some((k) => c.edges[k] !== 'WALL' && !isE(c.gi + D[k][0], c.gj + D[k][1]))); const pick = cab.length === 4 ? cab : near; const mean = (f) => pick.reduce((a, c) => a + f(c), 0) / pick.length; const cx = (mean((c) => c.gi) + 0.5) * C, cz = (mean((c) => c.gj) + 0.5) * C; const s0 = p.s; await b.teleport({ x: cx, z: cz, s: s0, yaw: p.yaw, pitch: 0 }); const programs0 = b.stats().render.programs; const trace = []; let lastS = null, polling = true; const poll = (async () => { while (polling) { const s = b.stats().player.s; if (s !== lastS) { trace.push(s); lastS = s; } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); } })(); const perf = await b.perf(16); polling = false; await poll; const s = b.stats(); const rides = trace.length - 1; const fail = []; if (perf.frameMs.max >= 50) fail.push('elevator: max frame ' + perf.frameMs.max.toFixed(1) + ' ms >= 50'); if (s.render.programs !== programs0) fail.push('elevator: programs ' + programs0 + ' -> ' + s.render.programs); if (rides < 1 || s.player.s === s0) fail.push('elevator: no ride within 16 s of standing in the cab (storey ' + s0 + ' -> ' + s.player.s + ', ' + rides + ' switch(es))'); return { perf, storey: [s0, s.player.s], rides, cab: pick.map((c) => [c.gi, c.gj]), storeys: trace, fail }; })()

perf.name: perf-high

soak.name: soak
eval: (async () => { const b = __backrooms; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await b.waitForIdle(20000); const s0 = b.stats(); const m0 = s0.memory; const bytes = (m) => (m ? m.texBytes + m.geoBytes : 0); const samples = []; let done = false; const walk = b.autowalk({ distance: 1500, speed: 6, seed: 7, heading: 0.6 }).then((r) => { done = true; return r; }); while (!done) { await sleep(2000); samples.push(b.stats().memory); } const r = await walk; const idle = await b.waitForIdle(30000); for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { await sleep(1000); samples.push(b.stats().memory); } const s = b.stats(); const fail = []; const maxMs = r.frameMsMax ?? r.frameMsMax5s; if (maxMs >= 50) fail.push('soak: max frame ' + maxMs.toFixed(1) + ' ms >= 50'); if (r.errors) fail.push('soak: ' + r.errors + ' errors'); if (r.stuck) fail.push('soak: autowalk got stuck after ' + r.distance.toFixed(0) + ' m'); if ((r.displacement ?? 0) < 400) fail.push('soak: the heading walk covered only ' + (r.displacement ?? 0).toFixed(0) + ' m of ground (< 400)'); if (s.render.programs !== s0.render.programs) fail.push('soak: programs ' + s0.render.programs + ' -> ' + s.render.programs); const liveTiles = (x) => x.tiles.resident + (x.tiles.otherStoreys ?? 0); const tileRatio = Math.max(1, liveTiles(s) / Math.max(1, liveTiles(s0))); const gStart = s0.render.geometries, gEnd = s.render.geometries, tStart = s0.render.textures - (s0.render.texturesPooled ?? 0), tEnd = s.render.textures - (s.render.texturesPooled ?? 0); const gMax = gStart * tileRatio * 1.1 + 16, tMax = tStart * tileRatio * 1.1 + 16; if (gEnd > gMax) fail.push('soak: geometries ' + gStart + ' -> ' + gEnd + ' after idle (bound ' + gMax.toFixed(0) + ' for ' + liveTiles(s0) + ' -> ' + liveTiles(s) + ' live tiles, other storeys included)'); if (tEnd > tMax) fail.push('soak: live textures ' + tStart + ' -> ' + tEnd + ' after idle, pool excluded (bound ' + tMax.toFixed(0) + ' for ' + liveTiles(s0) + ' -> ' + liveTiles(s) + ' live tiles, other storeys included)'); if ((s.render.texturesPooled ?? 0) > 256) fail.push('soak: texture pool holds ' + s.render.texturesPooled + ' textures (> 256)'); if (!idle || s.tiles.inFlight !== 0) fail.push('soak: in-flight jobs did not return to 0'); const MB = (v) => (v / 1048576).toFixed(0) + ' MB'; const budget = ({ low: 450, medium: 700, high: 900, ultra: 1400 }[s.quality] ?? 900) * 1048576; const peak = Math.max(bytes(m0), ...samples.map(bytes)); if (peak > budget * 1.15) fail.push('soak: resident tile GPU bytes peaked at ' + MB(peak) + ' (budget ' + MB(budget) + ' + 15 %)'); const last = samples.slice(-5); const endBytes = Math.min(...last.map(bytes)); const bytesMax = Math.max(bytes(m0) * tileRatio * 1.25, bytes(m0) + 64 * 1048576); if (endBytes > bytesMax) fail.push('soak: resident tile GPU bytes ' + MB(bytes(m0)) + ' -> ' + MB(endBytes) + ' (min of the last 5 samples; bound ' + MB(bytesMax) + ')'); const heap0 = m0 && m0.heapMB, heapEnd = Math.min(...last.map((m) => (m && m.heapMB !== null ? m.heapMB : Infinity))); const heapMax = heap0 !== null && heap0 !== undefined ? Math.max(heap0 * 2 + 64, 256) : Infinity; if (Number.isFinite(heapEnd) && heapEnd > heapMax) fail.push('soak: JS heap ' + heap0 + ' -> ' + heapEnd + ' MB (min of the last 5 samples; bound ' + heapMax.toFixed(0) + ')'); return { report: r, counts: { geometries: [gStart, r.geometriesEnd, gEnd], textures: [tStart, r.texturesEnd, tEnd], pooled: s.render.texturesPooled }, programs: [s0.render.programs, s.render.programs], tiles: [s0.tiles.resident, s.tiles.resident], otherStoreys: [s0.tiles.otherStoreys, s.tiles.otherStoreys], memory: { start: m0, peakBytesMB: +(peak / 1048576).toFixed(1), endBytesMB: +(endBytes / 1048576).toFixed(1), heapStart: heap0, heapEnd }, fail }; })()
soak.$note: R2: the geometry / texture / byte bounds compare the counts after the stream is idle again and scale with all live tiles, including the other storey a nearby tower / elevator / pit / glitch portal keeps prefetched (stats().tiles.otherStoreys); live textures exclude the capped texture pool (POOL_CAP per class)

stress.name: stress
eval: (async () => { const b = __backrooms; await b.waitForIdle(20000); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const s0 = b.stats(); const p = s0.player; const tex = (s) => s.render.textures - s.render.texturesPooled; for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) { const a = i * 2.39996, r = 60 + (i % 5) * 45; await b.teleport({ x: p.x + Math.cos(a) * r, z: p.z + Math.sin(a) * r }); } await b.teleport({ x: p.x, z: p.z, s: p.s, yaw: p.yaw, pitch: p.pitch }); await b.waitForIdle(30000); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const s = b.stats(); const fail = []; const g0 = s0.render.geometries, g1 = s.render.geometries, t0 = tex(s0), t1 = tex(s); if (Math.abs(g1 - g0) > Math.max(8, g0 * 0.1)) fail.push('stress: geometries ' + g0 + ' -> ' + g1); if (Math.abs(t1 - t0) > Math.max(8, t0 * 0.1)) fail.push('stress: textures ' + t0 + ' -> ' + t1); if (s.errors.length) fail.push('stress: errors ' + s.errors.length); return { geometries: [g0, g1], textures: [t0, t1], fail }; })()

edge.name: edge-low
eval: (async () => { const b = __backrooms; let maxFading = 0; const bands = []; const walk = b.autowalk({ distance: 384, speed: 3.2, seed: 3 }); let done = false; walk.then(() => { done = true; }); let n = 0; while (!done) { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); maxFading = Math.max(maxFading, b.stats().tiles.fadingIn); if (++n % 20 === 0) { const st = await b.imageStats([0, 0.38, 1, 0.24]); bands.push([+st.p5.toFixed(3), +st.p95.toFixed(3)]); } } const r = await walk; const fail = []; if (maxFading > 8) fail.push('edge: tiles.fadingIn reached ' + maxFading + ' (> 8)'); if ((r.frameMsMax ?? r.frameMsMax5s) >= 50) fail.push('edge: max frame ' + (r.frameMsMax ?? r.frameMsMax5s).toFixed(1) + ' ms'); return { maxFading, horizonBands: bands, walk: r, fail }; })()
